install: bash -c 'set -euo pipefail; sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get update -qq; sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends pstack; command -v pstack >/dev/null; PTUF_VERSION=${PTUF_VERSION:-v0.6.0}; curl -LsSf "https://github.com/watany-dev/ptuf/releases/download/${PTUF_VERSION}/ptuf-installer.sh" | sh; export PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH"; ptuf --version'
